# FG-REPO-0031

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_incomplete_index_is_never_a_silent_pass` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 仕様の索引が上限に達したため、一部しか読めていません。結果は読めた範囲のものです。仕様のファイルを分けるか小さくしてください。
- en: The specification index hit a bound, so only part of it was read; the results are about what was read. Split or shrink the specification files.
- id: Indeks spesifikasi mencapai batas sehingga hanya sebagian yang terbaca; hasilnya hanya untuk bagian yang terbaca. Pecah atau perkecil berkas spesifikasi.

## 原因 (cause)

Indexing a commit's requirements (M3 X4, forge-checks spec_index: `forge/spec-lint`, `forge/spec-trace` and the spec API `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/specs/…`) stops at its bounds rather than run unbounded: at most 1000 Markdown files under the specification directories (`spec_files`), at most 8 MiB read in all (`spec_bytes`; a single file over 256 KiB is not read and is the problem file_too_large instead), and at most 8 MiB of `git grep` output for the `@req` tags (`tag_lines`). The first bound hit is named; the answers are about what was read and never claim more: spec-lint concludes `neutral` instead of `success`, spec-trace `neutral`, and the API answers carry `incomplete: <reason>` with this code. Not a server fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The run's summary or the API's `incomplete` names the bound. Count the files: gstn browse tree --project <id> --ref <rev> --path spec. The job's log event `forge.spec_index.recorded` carries `incomplete` with `request_id`.

## 対処 (fix)

Keep the specification within the bounds: fewer, smaller Markdown files under the specification directories (split a large one), or list only the specification directories in `.forge/repo.yml` `path:` entries. Nothing to change on the server.
